nora_cs: Hey team :wave: Customer 'BrightReader' is hitting 403 on generation and rerank endpoints with their svcacct key, but embeddings succeed. They opened a ticket and pasted a curl repro.
nora_cs: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-svc-XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'

nora_cs: Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing:inference.generate"}

sam_eng: Can you paste the key id (last 6) and the org id? quick check: is this an org-level key or a service account key? :thinking:

nora_cs: key id ends with -a7b3c4, org: org_0812. It's a service account key created via our SSO provisioning flow.

mohit_infra: Looks like provisioning mapping dropped the inference scopes. That flow sometimes only grants embeds when the role is 'vector-service' vs 'inference-service'. Can you share the provisioning audit event id from the ticket?

nora_cs: audit_id=prov-2026-04-07-3345. Customer says they rotated the key in their console and embeddings started working earlier (confusing), but generation still 403.

kevin_se: Quick hypothesis: token has scopes ["embeddings:read", "embeddings:write"] but lacks ["inference:generate", "rerank:call"]. If rotation reissued a partial scope set, client's calls to /v1/embeddings would succeed but /v1/generate and /v1/rerank would be blocked.

sam_eng: Can we run a lookup against the auth-service for key suffix -a7b3c4? I can do that if you give me a 👍 from customer or internal approval.

nora_cs: Customer gave approval in ticket. Please proceed.

provisioner-bot: [automated] Retrieved key metadata for sk-svc-XXXX: owner=svcacct:brightreader-search, scopes=[embeddings.read, embeddings.write], created=2026-04-07T14:12:08Z, provisioner=ssoprovision-v2

mohit_infra: Confirmed. Provisioner v2 bug: when role claim contains both `vectors` and `search`, we only translate to embeddings scopes. We'll need a fix to map to inference and rerank too.

kevin_se: Workaround: create a service account role that includes inference privileges and reissue a key, or temporarily attach an API key with org-level inference to the service. Both are options while we patch provisioner.

nora_cs: I shared both options with the customer and gave the repro steps for reissuing a key. They prefer a non-disruptive workaround: attach an org-managed key to the connector.

sam_eng: I'll open an internal bug and link here.
sam_eng: https://redwood.internal/bugs/PROV-9921

mohit_infra: Patch: provisioner-v2 0.12.3 will include role->scope mapping fix. ETA for deploy to staging: 2 hours. I'll follow up after canary.

nora_cs: Customer accepted the org-key workaround and will test today. I'll mark this as escalated -> provisioning team. Thanks all :pray:

kevin_se: Follow-up action: provisioning, add regression test for composite role claims. Also schedule a retro on role->scope flattening.

nora_cs: Closing loop with customer after they validate. If they still see 403 after attaching org-key, we'll reopen and collect `x-request-id` headers for last failing calls.
